Package dev.turboism.sdk.ui

Interface UiHostCapabilityService

public interface UiHostCapabilityService
UI-host service surface for SDK-only plugins.

Plugins submit descriptors and receive registration handles or SDK-safe values. Implementations own host UI adaptation, scheduling, placement, disposal, and file/dialog/status behavior. This API must not expose Swing, AWT, Cubism host widgets, native handles, or raw host objects.

    • confirmDialog

      boolean confirmDialog(DialogRequest request)
      Requests a yes/no confirmation for the given dialog descriptor.

      Implementations must perform the same permission checks as openDialog(DialogRequest) and must not expose host widgets. Returning false means the user declined or the host cancelled.

    • openChoiceDialog

      default void openChoiceDialog(ChoiceDialogRequest request, ChoiceDialogResultListener listener)
      Opens a bounded runtime-rendered choice dialog without blocking the caller.

      Returns immediately after scheduling the dialog on the UI thread. The listener receives the selected option id and the secondary action id (or nulls for accept/cancel) once the user closes the dialog.

      Activates an embedded panel owned by the calling plugin.

      Hosts that do not provide a verified panel surface fail closed.

    • activateEmbeddedPanelFloating

      default void activateEmbeddedPanelFloating(EmbeddedPanelId panelId)
      Activates an embedded panel owned by the calling plugin as a floating window (Photoshop-style popup). Hosts that do not provide a verified floating surface fail closed to plain activation.

    • contributeCollapsibleSection

      default Registration contributeCollapsibleSection(CollapsibleSectionContribution contribution)
      Injects a collapsible section into an existing embedded panel (including the Turboism tab turboism.panel.main).

      Injected sections are appended after the panel's declared content during render synthesis and ordered by order then sectionId. Hosts that do not provide a verified panel surface fail closed.

    • requestFile

      Optional<String> requestFile(FileChooserRequest request)

    • currentColorMode

      default UiHostColorMode currentColorMode()
      Reports the host's active color theme mode (Cubism light/dark). Used by plugins to filter base-compatible options such as theme packages.

    • hostLocale

      default Locale hostLocale()
      Returns the Cubism Editor UI language (host JVM locale), used by plugins to select localized presentation.

      Returns the effective UI language: zh builds are normalized to zh-Hans/zh-Hant (zh-CN/zh-SG → zh-Hans, zh-TW/zh-HK/zh-MO → zh-Hant, other script-less zh such as Wine-rewritten zh-US → zh-Hans); non-zh languages are returned unchanged. The raw host JVM locale may be rewritten by Proton/Wine (e.g. zh-US) and does not represent the actual UI language.

      Returns:
      the current effective Cubism UI language, never null

    • openDirectory

      default void openDirectory(StoragePath directory)
      Opens the host file manager at the given plugin storage directory. Implementations must confine the resolved directory to the plugin's storage roots and fail closed when the host cannot open directories.

    • openFormDialog

      default void openFormDialog(FormDialogRequest request, FormDialogResultListener listener)
      Opens a bounded runtime-rendered form dialog (text and color fields) without blocking the caller. The listener receives the field values when the user accepts, a secondary action id when one is pressed, or an empty map on cancel.

    • openColorPicker

      default void openColorPicker(String id, String title, String initialColorHex, ColorPickerResultListener listener)
      Opens a bounded runtime-rendered color picker without blocking the caller. The listener receives true with a canonical #RRGGBB value when the user confirms, or false with null on cancel. initialColorHex may be null or a canonical #RRGGBB value; invalid values fall back to the picker default.

    • notifyStatus

      Registration notifyStatus(StatusNotification notification)
      Replaces the current ordinary bottom-status message and records the same message through the calling plugin's framework logger. Compact resident metrics retain their own keyed slots.
      Parameters:
      notification - validated status message and severity
      Returns:
      a handle that dismisses this message only while it remains current
